Below is my report on using Qwen3-Max on the written part of homework 8.

Overall, I'm very impressed by Qwen3-Max's performance on this homework. It seems like it really does well on the questions where it needs to fill in or do multiple choice, i. e., problems 3 and 4. The main issues I had were in the second half of problem 1, which was regarding computational efficiency; it had a hard time accurately responding in text along with giving a mathematical reasoning.
